title: News and notes from the first day of acclimation practices from Broncos Camp

sources.title: News and notes from the first day of acclimation practices from Broncos Camp
sources.description: We’re officially back! The Denver Broncos returned to the practice field today for their first of two acclimation/ramp up practices before training camp officially kicks off on Friday. This was a lighter non-padded practice allowing the players to work themselves back into action before things get going later in the week. Also, due to fans […]
